studies.title: PB 与 ROE：估值和盈利能力的配对检验
studies.summary: 同一候选池的五种历史排序中，加入静态 ROE 后收益和信息比率低于仅用 PB 的对照；这不等于 ROE 普遍无效。
studies.source_note: 数值取自已公开并逐项核对的市场研究专题；原始财报版本和完整交易回放尚未独立复核。
rows: 质量调整 PB + ROE 变化
findings: 仅用 PB 的对照仍要求 ROE 可计算，不能当作完全不依赖 ROE 数据的纯 PB 组合。
放宽 ROE 非空要求后，合格股票月记录增加 46,803 条，约占扩大样本的 7.11%。
质量条件对结果有影响，但多项条件同时变化，不能归因于单个过滤器。
limits: 历史财报修订和公告可见时间尚未逐份独立核验。
整个历史区间参与过探索，不能重新标作严格样本外。
执行采用日线近似，缺少完整市场冲击和真实成交回放。

en-US.title: PB and ROE: A Paired Test of Valuation and Profitability
en-US.summary: Across five historical rankings on the same candidate pool, adding static ROE produced lower returns and information ratios than the PB-only comparison. This does not establish that ROE is generally ineffective.
en-US.source_note: Values come from a public market research study reviewed item by item; original filing versions and the complete trade replay have not been independently rechecked.
rows: Quality adjusted PB + change in ROE
findings: The PB-only comparison still requires ROE to be computable, so it should not be treated as a pure PB portfolio that is independent of ROE data.
Relaxing the non-null ROE requirement added 46,803 eligible stock-month records, about 7.11% of the expanded sample.
Quality conditions affect the result, but several conditions changed at the same time, so the effect cannot be attributed to a single filter.
limits: Historical filing revisions and announcement availability have not been independently checked record by record.
The full historical interval participated in exploration and cannot be relabeled as a strict out-of-sample period.
Execution uses a daily approximation and lacks a complete market impact and trade execution replay.

studies.title: 研发投入相对估值：信号还是规模暴露？
studies.summary: 将公告事件 PIT 历史重建向前延伸后，2019 年 3–12 月新增 10 个合格月度截面；研发 / 市值、研发 / EV 和资本化研发在 20/220 日呈探索性正 Rank IC，中性化后减弱。2015–2018 年无法形成符合最低样本要求的年度证据，且历史修订链不完整。
studies.source_note: 扩展后的聚合回放使用 sealed announcement-event PIT vintage=20260926，行情截至 2026-09-30。2019 是回溯历史重建敏感性分析；历史财务修订链不完整（revision_safe=false）。仅发布月度横截面聚合统计。
rows: 规模/价值/动量/杠杆/行业中性化残差
findings: 2019 年 3–12 月可形成十个合格月度截面，但属于回溯重建敏感性；2015 年缺少 2014 年 TTM 回看数据，2016–2018 年每月横截面最大仅 1、1、2 只，不满足 200 只下限。
扩展样本中研发 / 市值、研发 / EV 和资本化研发呈探索性正向 Rank IC；220 日标签高度重叠，不能按独立样本解读。
对规模、价值、动量、杠杆和行业中性化后 Rank IC 下降但仍为正；不能据此认定独立、可交易的研发 Alpha。研发增长、研发 / 收入和研发 / 资产表现较弱。
年度图汇总的是月度横截面统计算术均值，不是自然年组合回报；2019 单独标为回溯敏感性点。
修正口径后已重跑固定 Top-200 成本探针：25bp 单边成本下研发 / 市值年化 12.70%、Sharpe 0.57、最大回撤 -25.75%；成本敏感性随成本上升而走弱。该探针不是预注册十分组验证；前瞻最终 OOS 尚未成熟，继续作为研究候选，不进入策略或生产。
分母拆解中，2020+ 样本的倒数市值 Rank IC（20/220 日：5.92%/15.74%）强于 log 研发费用分子（-0.18%/-2.14%）；规模/价值/动量/杠杆/行业中性化残差仍为正（1.99%/5.62%）。这提示原始收益不能归因于研发投入本身。
Newey–West HAC 区间与 14 项 Rank IC 检验的 BH 校正、CPCV 选择偏差诊断已补充；这些推断依赖月度重叠标签且仍属探索，不能解决历史修订链缺失。
limits: 行情覆盖从 2015-01-05 开始，但行情起始不等于因子起始。当前 sealed PIT 输入缺少构造 2015 年首个交易日 TTM 所需的 2014 年回看数据。另一份本地旧版原始 vintage 中，2014 年有正研发费用记录的公司仅 1 家，远低于 200 只下限，未混入主回放。2016–2018 年可用横截面分别最多只有 1、1、2 只；2019-03 起的十个月来自回溯历史重建，不是修订安全回测；revision_safe=false。
图表逐年值是各月 Rank IC / 分组收益差的算术均值，不是自然年复利组合收益；220 日前瞻标签重叠，年度点不是独立检验，现已补充 HAC 置信区间及多重检验校正，但月度重叠标签仍限制推断。
CSI300/500/1000 使用历史权重快照与前一快照敏感性检查，但缺乏独立生效/公告时间；CSI2000 从本地 2023-08 可用窗口开始。

口径修正后的回放现已重跑固定 Top-200 成本探针与描述性 CPCV，但不能替代预注册十分组验证。此前记录的四个月探索后 fwd20 Top-10% 毛收益保留窗口（2026-04 至 2026-07）中，七个变体的毛收益均为负。该观察记录于 2026-09-29，晚于同日预注册日志；现有记录不能独立证明窗口在探索前已封存，因此这一短窗口并非预先封存的最终样本外检验。已封存 2026-10 至 2027-09 月末形成信号的前瞻最终样本外协议；须待 220 日标签成熟后才能计算。成分股生效时点审计仍未完成。
公开展示只含聚合值，不含逐证券信号、权重、私有数据路径或生产结论。

en-US.title: R&D Investment Relative to Valuation: Signal or Size Exposure?
en-US.summary: An extended sealed announcement-event PIT reconstruction adds ten eligible monthly cross-sections from March–December 2019. R&D/market cap, R&D/EV, and capitalized R&D show exploratory positive Rank IC at 20- and 220-day horizons, weaker after neutralization. 2015–2018 cannot support the minimum cross-sectional sample, and historical revisions are incomplete.
en-US.period: 20-day labels: 2019-03-29 to 2026-08-31, 90 valid monthly cross-sections; 220-day labels: 2019-03-29 to 2025-10-31, 80 cross-sections (fewer for R&D growth)
en-US.source_note: Extended aggregate replay using sealed announcement-event PIT vintage=20260926 and market data through 2026-09-30. 2019 is a retrospective historical-reconstruction sensitivity, not revision-safe evidence (revision_safe=false). Only monthly cross-sectional aggregates are published.
findings: Ten eligible monthly cross-sections are available for March–December 2019, but only as a retrospective reconstruction sensitivity. The 2015 snapshot lacks 2014 TTM lookback; 2016–2018 monthly cross-sections contain at most 1, 1, and 2 eligible names, below the 200-name minimum.
In the extended sample, R&D/market cap, R&D/EV, and capitalized R&D show exploratory positive Rank IC; 220-day labels overlap and are not independent observations.

Neutralizing size, value, momentum, leverage, and industry lowers Rank IC, which remains positive; this does not establish independent or tradable R&D alpha. R&D growth, R&D/revenue, and R&D/assets are weaker.
Annual chart values are arithmetic means of monthly cross-sectional statistics, not calendar-year portfolio returns; the 2019 point is separately marked as retrospective sensitivity.

A fixed Top-200 cost probe was rerun after correcting definitions: R&D/market cap annualizes to 12.70% with 0.57 Sharpe and -25.75% max drawdown at 25bp one-way cost; results weaken as costs rise. This is not the preregistered decile validation, and prospective final OOS has not matured. Keep this as a research candidate; do not use it as a strategy or in production.

In the 2020+ numerator/denominator check, inverse market cap has stronger univariate Rank IC than log R&D expense (20/220-day: 5.92%/15.74% vs -0.18%/-2.14%). The size/value/momentum/leverage/industry-neutralized residual remains positive (1.99%/5.62%), so the raw result cannot be attributed to R&D investment alone.

Newey–West HAC intervals, BH adjustment across 14 Rank IC tests, and a CPCV selection-bias diagnostic are now reported. Overlapping monthly labels and incomplete historical revisions still limit inference.
limits: Market data begins on 2015-01-05, but that is not the factor start. The sealed PIT input lacks the 2014 lookback needed to form TTM on the first 2015 session. A separate legacy raw vintage has positive 2014 R&D expense for only one issuer, far below the 200-name minimum, and is not mixed into the primary replay. 2016–2018 have at most 1, 1, and 2 eligible names per monthly cross-section; the ten observations from 2019-03 onward are retrospective reconstruction sensitivity, not revision-safe evidence (revision_safe=false).

Annual chart values are arithmetic means of monthly Rank IC / group return spreads, not compounded calendar-year portfolio returns; 220-day forward labels overlap, so annual points are not independent tests. HAC intervals and multiple-testing adjustments are now reported, but overlapping monthly labels still limit inference.
CSI300/500/1000 use historical weight snapshots and a prior-snapshot sensitivity check, but lack independent effective/announcement timestamps; CSI2000 starts in the available 2023-08 window.

A four-month Top-10% gross-return diagnostic for 2026-04 to 2026-07 was recorded on 2026-09-29, after the preregistration event logged on that date. The available record does not independently establish that this window was sealed before exploration. It is therefore a retrospective reserved-window diagnostic, not a prospective or final OOS test; all seven variants were negative. The corrected replay now includes a fixed Top-200 cost probe and descriptive CPCV, but this does not replace preregistered decile validation. A prospective final OOS is frozen for 2026-10 through 2027-09 formations and cannot be evaluated until its 220-day labels mature. The constituent effective-time audit remains incomplete.
The public view contains aggregates only, not per-security signals, weights, private data paths, or production conclusions.

research_log.note: 从研发 / 市值线索出发，明确区分研发投入信息与市值分母带来的规模、估值暴露。
research_log.note_en: Started from the R&D/market-cap observation and separated the R&D signal question from size and valuation effects embedded in the denominator.

research_log.stage: 预注册七个变体并进行 sealed PIT 回放
research_log.stage_en: Seven variants preregistered and replayed on sealed PIT data
research_log.note: 固定七种研发定义、公告事件可用日、月度截面和 20/220 交易日前瞻标签；保留聚合诊断。
research_log.note_en: Fixed seven R&D definitions, announcement-event availability, monthly cross-sections, and 20/220-trading-day forward labels; retained aggregate diagnostics.

research_log.stage: 记录回顾性保留窗口诊断
research_log.note: 记录 2026-04 至 2026-07 的四个月 fwd20 Top-10% 毛收益观察，七个变体均为负。该记录晚于同日预注册日志；现有证据不能独立证明窗口事先封存，故不称为前瞻或最终样本外检验。
research_log.note_en: Recorded the four-month fwd20 Top-10% gross-return observation for 2026-04 to 2026-07; all seven variants were negative. The record postdates the preregistration log on the same day, and available evidence does not independently establish prior sealing, so this is not called prospective or final out-of-sample evidence.

research_log.stage: 修正因子定义口径并重放
research_log.note: 修正 PIT 因子定义口径后重算月度 Rank IC 与分组聚合。旧版平台 Top-200 探针、交易成本、CPCV 和最终 OOS 未随本次重放更新，因此仍为初步研究。
research_log.note_en: Recomputed monthly Rank IC and grouped aggregates after correcting PIT factor definitions. The older platform Top-200 probe, transaction costs, CPCV, and final OOS were not rerun with this replay, so the work remains preliminary.

research_log.stage: 将历史行情回补至 2015 并检查 PIT 覆盖
research_log.stage_en: Extended the historical replay to 2015 and audited PIT coverage
research_log.note: 修正 PIT 因子定义口径后重算月度 Rank IC 与分组聚合；当时尚未更新旧版平台 Top-200、交易成本、CPCV 和最终 OOS。本阶段后续补跑见 2026-10-01 记录。
research_log.note_en: Recomputed monthly Rank IC and grouped aggregates after correcting PIT factor definitions. At that point, the older platform Top-200 probe, costs, CPCV, and final OOS had not yet been updated; subsequent checks are recorded on 2026-10-01.

research_log.stage: 补充成本、推断与分母归因；封存前瞻 OOS 协议
research_log.stage_en: Added cost, inference, and denominator attribution; froze prospective OOS protocol
research_log.note: 基于同一修正版 PIT 回放补跑固定 Top-200 成本阶梯、Newey–West HAC 与 BH 多重检验、CPCV 和研发分子/市值分母拆解。倒数市值单变量信号明显强于研发费用分子；结果仍属探索。另封存 2026-10 至 2027-09 前瞻窗口协议，待 220 日标签成熟后解封。
research_log.note_en: Reran fixed Top-200 cost tiers, Newey–West HAC with BH adjustment, CPCV, and R&D-numerator/market-cap-denominator attribution on the corrected PIT replay. The inverse-market-cap component is stronger than the R&D expense numerator; evidence remains exploratory. Froze a 2026-10 through 2027-09 prospective window protocol, to be unsealed only after 220-day labels mature.

top200_cost_probe.method: Monthly month-end, equal-weight top 200, next eligible session execution, platform period cost vector scaled from the 25bp BpsCostModel run; all-market eligible names.

studies.title: 职工薪酬与人力资本：待检验的基本面线索
studies.summary: 早期基本面脚本使用过职工薪酬相关报表字段，但尚无可核对的预测性回测，不能据此认定劳动成本因子有效。
studies.period: 尚无可发布的历史评估区间
studies.source_note: 仅依据已保留的历史字段与因子脚本建立研究入口；没有公开收益统计。
findings: 应付职工薪酬是期末负债余额，不能直接当作当期工资或研发人员投入。
后续需分别核对劳动成本流量、人员规模和报表披露覆盖。
limits: 尚未完成数据口径、历史版本和公告时点核验。
没有 Rank IC、分组收益或交易回测结果。

en-US.title: Employee Compensation and Human Capital: A Fundamental Clue to Test
en-US.summary: Early fundamental scripts used employee compensation fields from financial statements, but there is no auditable predictive backtest yet. The labor cost factor cannot be considered effective on this basis.
en-US.period: No publishable historical evaluation period yet
en-US.source_note: This research entry is based only on retained historical fields and factor scripts; no public return statistics are available.
findings: Employee benefits payable is an end-of-period liability balance and cannot be used directly as current-period wages or R&D staff investment.
Future work must separately verify labor cost flows, workforce size, and financial statement disclosure coverage.
limits: Data definitions, historical versions, and announcement timing have not been verified.
There are no Rank IC, grouped return, or trading backtest results.

studies.title: 现金流指数：规则复现与策略边界
studies.summary: 现金流、红利和相关自建组合已有部分规则复现与聚合回放证据，但尚不能视为完整的官方成分复现或生产策略验证。
studies.period: 可用成分快照覆盖期；完整十年官方成分回放尚未完成
studies.source_note: 数据取自量化研究仓库的公开研究入口；官方指数、规则重建影子指数和自建组合分属不同证据类型。
rows: 全市场自由现金流基准
findings: 可用成分快照上的日收益相关性支持规则研究和本地校准，但不等于完整官方成分复现。
980092、932365 和 000922 需要区分当前研究对象、广义基准和红利基准。
后续仍需核对历史规则变化、点时财报覆盖、规模/行业/估值/质量归因和统一交易成本。
limits: 可用成分快照不覆盖完整十年官方历史成分和规则变更。
公开投影只保留聚合结果，不代表逐股票信号、组合权重或可成交回放。
尚未据此进入生产策略或形成完整样本外结论。

en-US.title: Cash Flow Indices: Rule Reproduction and Strategy Boundaries
en-US.summary: Cash flow, dividend, and related self-built portfolios have partial rule reproduction and aggregate replay evidence, but this is not yet a complete reproduction of official constituents or a production strategy validation.
en-US.period: Period covered by available constituent snapshots; the complete ten-year official constituent replay is not complete
en-US.source_note: Data comes from the public research entry in the quantitative research repository. The official index, the rule-reconstructed shadow index, and the self-built portfolio are separate evidence types.
findings: Daily return correlations on available constituent snapshots support rule research and local calibration, but do not establish a complete reproduction of official constituents.
980092, 932365, and 000922 must be distinguished as the current research object, a broad benchmark, and a dividend benchmark.
Further work must check historical rule changes, point-in-time filing coverage, size/industry/valuation/quality attribution, and a unified transaction cost assumption.
limits: Available constituent snapshots do not cover the complete ten-year history of official constituents and rule changes.
The public projection keeps aggregate results only and does not represent per-security signals, portfolio weights, or executable replay.
This has not entered a production strategy or produced a complete out-of-sample conclusion.
